name: mike · performance de carga · identidad v6
instructions: Create draft, search reuse, complete source/style/scale fields, adopt only after validation. Technical success is not artistic acceptance.

production.prompt: Identity-preserving production game sprites derived from the attached canonical character. The EXACT youthful adult male elf Mike: blue eyes, long blond hair tied behind, pointed ears, blue robe with detailed gold trim, BLACK gloves, black boots, red-brown gold spellbook, sheathed dagger. Do not feminize, change face or use chibi proportions. His book is deliberately secured in its belt pouch whenever BOTH hands work; otherwise keep it in his anatomical LEFT arm. Gloves stay black in every pose. Eight chronological phases: first SIX form one gentle mandolin-playing loop (fingers on frets, right hand strums, small head movements, planted feet). Frame7: one wrong note, surprised but still holding mandolin properly. Frame8: embarrassed, instrument held calmly. Instrument is painted into every pose and always supported by hands. No floating instrument or musical-note graphics. Fixed southeast three-quarter view of hero facing RIGHT, exactly the canonical face, proportions, costume, palette and pixel-painted rendering of the reference, no redesign. A regular EXACT FOUR columns by TWO rows grid, eight complete isolated frames in reading order. ALL figures fully visible inside their cells with generous transparent safety margins. Constant body scale in all frames, shortened crouched silhouette is NOT a smaller person. Landscape 2:1 sheet, each cell contains only the hero. Real transparent background; no ground, shadows, labels, numbers, borders or text. High detail at native size, ideally 350+ pixels for standing human figure per cell. Do not use old loading-character designs.
